result.reason: The clause meets the fallback position: it retains 12-month automatic renewals, reduces the non-renewal notice period to 30 days (within the 60-day maximum), and preserves the existing price-increase cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%, which is stricter than the 5% fallback cap. The edit is narrowly tailored and professionally drafted. It does not fully achieve the preferred position because it lacks a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal, but the fallback is satisfied.
